story.markdown_sample:
# Markdown Preview

This is a Markdown component. It supports various elements:

## Typography
- Bold text
- *Italic text*
- ~~Strikethrough~~

## Lists
1. First item
2. Second item
   - Sub item A
   - Sub item B

## Code
Inline `const x = 10;` and blocks:

```javascript
function hello() {
  console.log("Hello, world!");
}
```

## Tables
| Feature | Supported |
| --- | --- |
| GFM | Yes |
| Custom Styles | Yes |

---

> This is a quote.
